title: The Fourth, 2019 · before
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The day before: the Lanes' sign across the bay being tested for the holiday, letters flickering on one at a time from the roofline, and Wood on the dock counting the ones that don't come back. Seven. The strip draws the test from across the water, small, and the count in his mouth, unlettered.

panels.composition: The dock at dusk. Across the bay, the Lanes' sign on the roofline, letters coming on one by one. WOOD at the rail. The PUP.
